text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali has telephone talk with French President Chirac on reinforcing partnership.
- Tunisia celebrates Associations Day; ceremony in Carthage Palace to be chaired by president.
- President confers with Trade Minister Zenaidi on foreign trade results during first quarter.
- President tells customs director-general Ammar to adapt legislation and procedural rules to modernisation of economy and opening up to outside world.
- Rainfall in central and northern Tunisia.
- President recommends increasing trade exchanges with Arab and African countries.
- Higher Education Minister Jazi says number of students in year 2001 will reach 205,000, up from 125,000 at present.
- Chinese Hebei province governor holds talks with Industry Minister Bouguerra on about 25 projects to be implemented in cooperation with China, mainly in fertiliser sector.
